metadata.note: Pearson correlations across tract-level rows. Correlation is descriptive and does not prove causation.

takeaways: Economic has the strongest domain-level relationship with overall YOI (r=0.809).
Economic and Health move together most strongly among domain pairs (r=0.734).
Standardized YOI (z-score) has the strongest indicator-level relationship with overall YOI (r=1.0).
